message.text:
**Identifying enforcement sites**

I need to figure out all the distinct enforcement sites and check their visibility and read access. I think I should look into the fileserver for attachment permissions and the memo service to see if I can check memo read access. Also, possibly RSS might filter public shares. It seems like I need to come up with at least three sources for this. I’ll also have to inspect authorization policies.

args.command: shopt -s globstar; awk '/Visibility|visibility|checkMemoReadAccess|AllowAnonymous|VisibilityList/ {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0}' server/**/*.go | awk 'NR<=220 {print}'
